client_brief:
Verda Reformer Studio: Verda campaign photography

Project overview
Verda is a boutique reformer pilates studio built on calm. We are hiring an expert to turn the supplied working files into Verda campaign photography, the studio's own room plus the licensed movement set, Instructor portrait set on the studio ground, and Launch page and mixed canvas social set as one editable document plus its source.

What we will provide
studio_frames/ (2 frames, approx 4032 x 3024); verda_logo_web.png (600 x 600); instructor_photos/ (6 self submitted portraits, 1100 to 4000 px); passcard_2025_print.pdf; roster_2027.csv; owner_note.txt. Every file must be accounted for in the final manifest; it may be used, retained as reference, superseded, or rejected with a reason.

Scope and deliverables
- Verda campaign photography, the studio's own room plus the licensed movement set: Two studio frames and the licensed frames brought to one calm daylight target (one white point, one black point, one warmth in the oak, one crop logic) without crossing the owners' stated do not want line, delivered as one wide hero and 1:1, 4:5 and 9:16...
- Instructor portrait set on the studio ground: Six self submitted portraits brought to one pass treatment: subject aware crops that never enlarge, and each instructor knocked onto the studio's solid ground so the set reads as one sitting rather than six phones. 
- Launch page and mixed canvas social set as one editable document plus its source: One professionally selected Adobe Express template adapted to the supplied brand, copy, and approved imagery. 

Non-negotiables
- Do not invent names, prices, claims, product features, locations, credentials, records, or documentary events that are absent from the approved inputs.
- Do not silently replace a weak supplied asset. Use it honestly, reject it with a reason, or take only the brief's declared Stock or concept exception.
- Preserve identity, product geometry, material behavior, and documentary truth; retouching may improve presentation but may not change what the subject is.

Working process
Please begin with an inventory and risk pass, submit the first proof or direction at the stated checkpoint, then revise against consolidated feedback. We are hiring for judgment: flag contradictions early, make the strongest defensible choice, and document any source limitation rather than hiding it.

Contract
$1,800-$4,500 fixed; target delivery 2 to 4 weeks; one direction checkpoint and two consolidated revision rounds. Final handoff includes the delivery manifest, editable sources where scoped, final exports, and a concise production note.

source_provenance.statement: The scenario is synthesized from the repository's laundered Upwork and Freelancer source anchors. It is not represented as a verbatim live listing.
source_provenance.original_anchor: The reconciled ledger carries NO verbatim posted brief for this row, and this task states that rather than inventing a quotation. It is anchored instead to the recurring shape that Upwork and Freelancer.com carry continuously in the small studio and wellness category: an owner opening or relaunching a space, with a logo file inherited from a departed designer, one or two phone photographs of their own room, no shoot budget, and a request to 'source some stock that fits our vibe and make our photos match it'. That request is exactly what the killed original modelled, and it is why the ledger's own triage recorded PHOTO-28 as sitting on two surfaces with no decision density: sourcing and match grading, on their own, are the first afternoon of the job. The fuller commission the studio actually has is the opening itself. The same owner who cannot afford a shoot also has a wordmark that exists only as a small web export, a printed founding member pass her printer ran last year from a file she does not hold, six instructors who sent their own portraits, and an opening date that has already moved once. The brand is coined for this benchmark; no real studio, person or trademark is named anywhere.

price_band_and_audience: Intro pack 180 dollars, membership 220 dollars a month, clients 28 to 48, mostly women in professional work who audition three studios before committing to one. The band is load bearing and it is a restraint band. At 220 a month the buyer is paying for calm, attention and space, so the campaign has to read as soft daylight, generous air, one body in one room, muted sage and oak, and type that is quiet. Push it down toward a 39 dollar high volume gym and the correct treatment inverts: bright, saturated, crowded, many bodies, heavy condensed type, price on the hero. Push it up into wellness luxury and it becomes near monochrome, editorial, almost empty, which at 220 a month reads as pretension and prices the studio out of its own neighbourhood. An agent that ships either extreme has misread the commission, and the owners have already named the failure themselves: a room that reads as a different brand from the campaign photography. A posted job of this shape runs 900 to 2,200 dollars fixed.

brand_identity.founded_place_size: Founded 2022, first studio run for four years; opening a second location on Calloway Row in a North American city. Owner led by Marit and Dana, with six instructors. Small, independent, growing to two rooms.
brand_identity.about: Verda is a boutique reformer pilates studio built on calm. One body, one room, generous air, and unhurried attention. Marit and Dana have run a single studio for four years and are now opening a second on Calloway Row. The studio is deliberately the opposite of a chain gym: no crowding, no shouting, no gloss of the everyday. What clients pay for is space, focus and a considered environment they return to.
brand_identity.audience: Considered buyers, mostly women in professional work, aged 28 to 48. They typically audition three studios before committing to one, and they are paying for calm, attention and space rather than volume or intensity.
brand_identity.price_positioning: Premium neighborhood, not luxury. Intro pack 180 dollars, membership 220 a month. Positioned above a high volume budget gym and below wellness luxury: the tone is soft daylight and quiet confidence, never pretension and never a discount.
brand_identity.typography: Quiet and editorial. A light, humanist serif for headlines paired with a restrained sans for body and labels. Generous spacing, small type, nothing condensed, bold or promotional.
brand_identity.voice: Plain, warm and unhurried. Speaks to one person rather than a crowd. Confident without hype, and honest about what the room actually is.
brand_identity.brand_assets_status: No brand guidelines were ever written. The wordmark was drawn by a designer who has since left, and the only surviving file is a small low resolution web export she handed over. There is no master artwork, no color specification and no font list on record, so the freelancer inherits the studio look from this brief and from the room itself.
brand_identity.values: Calm, attention, generous space, and honesty about the room a client will actually walk into.

assets_supplied.name: studio_frames/ (2 frames, approx 4032 x 3024)
assets_supplied.kind: Two handheld phone photographs of the new Calloway Row room, taken by the owners on the late afternoon the fit out finished: one wide across the reformers toward the front window, one closer on a single reformer and the oak floor.
assets_supplied.visible_description: "The only two pictures we have of the new room. Taken on our phones the afternoon the fit out finished."
assets_supplied.hidden_defect: The front window is fully clipped in the frame that composes best wide, so the recovery move that would bring detail back runs, reports success, and returns an image in which nothing has moved. Separately the room is under two illuminants at once, ceiling LED and street sodium coming through that window, so the sage reformer upholstery and the oak floor need opposite corrections to arrive at one daylight white point and a single global move cannot take both.

assets_supplied.name: verda_logo_web.png (600 x 600)
assets_supplied.kind: The only surviving file of the studio wordmark, a small web export left behind by the designer who drew it.
assets_supplied.visible_description: "What our old designer left. It is small and it has a white square behind it."
assets_supplied.hidden_defect: It is a 600 px JPEG artefacted export with an opaque white square baked behind it, so it halos on the sage panel and cannot carry a printed card at any usable size. The artefact ring around the letterforms means an ink level selection returns a soft grey fringe rather than a clean edge, and the wordmark's two enclosed counters cannot be punched by a background removal at all.

assets_supplied.name: instructor_photos/ (6 self submitted portraits, 1100 to 4000 px)
assets_supplied.kind: Six portraits the instructors took or supplied themselves, on phones, in different rooms, for the founding member pass.
assets_supplied.visible_description: "The six instructors sent their own pictures. They are what they are."
assets_supplied.hidden_defect: Two instructors shot against a cream studio wall wearing pale oat tops, so subject and ground sit at the same luminance and the knockout reports success while biting into a shoulder line and eating a hair fringe on one side only. A third portrait is 1100 px on the long edge, below anything the printed pass can carry, and nothing can enlarge it.

assets_supplied.name: passcard_2025_print.pdf
assets_supplied.kind: The printer's flat press PDF for last year's founding member pass, 89 x 51 mm landscape, fonts embedded, produced from a real page layout so it converts cleanly. Carries the instructor name, the class, the price, a validity line and a contact line, plus a placed portrait and the studio mark.
assets_supplied.visible_description: "What our printer sent to press last year. We do not have the working file."
assets_supplied.hidden_defect: The printed pass plainly shows a portrait and the studio mark as two placed pictures and four separate blocks of copy, but the mark was flattened into the card's background artwork before it went to press and the copy was set as one continuous flow. The converted document therefore exposes a single graphic frame and a single text story, nothing announces it, and any mapping authored against the second graphic frame the printed page implies is silently dropped while the preparation step still reports success.

assets_supplied.name: roster_2027.csv
assets_supplied.kind: Export from the studio's scheduling system, one row per instructor, with columns for instructor, class, price, validity, contact and a portrait filename.
assets_supplied.visible_description: "The six instructors, their classes and the new prices."
assets_supplied.hidden_defect: An instructor who left in the spring is still on the roster, so the export carries seven rows for six passes. The class column holds the internal scheduling codes rather than the names the studio uses with clients, and the portrait filenames carry an extension that does not match the files actually supplied.

assets_supplied.name: owner_note.txt
assets_supplied.kind: A page from Marit: the six instructors and what each teaches, the opening date history, what the campaign must not look like in her own words, and how she talks about the room.
assets_supplied.visible_description: "The instructors, the classes, and what we do not want this to look like."

emergent_checkpoints.what_can_only_be_learned_by_running: Whether the front window in the wide composing studio frame has anything left in it. The recovery move runs, reports success, and returns an image in which the readout is that nothing has moved: the window is clipped in every channel, so there is no detail under it to lift and the tool has nothing to do. Every later move toward the calm daylight target then pushes the rest of the room while that rectangle stays flat white, and it gets worse rather than better as the room around it comes down to a daylight value. There is no histogram, no eyedropper and no measurement anywhere in the connector, so whether a phone exposure at dusk held the window is unknowable until the attempt is made and the result is looked at.
emergent_checkpoints.why_unavoidable: (a) No ordering avoids it and no care prevents it, because the only channel that reports on this exposure is the attempt itself, and the frame that composes best wide is the frame with the window in it. (b) Nothing states it. The brief says the two pictures were taken on phones on a late afternoon, which is the owners' account of when they were taken, and asks for calm daylight, which is the requirement. Neither is a disclosure that a channel is clipped. (c) It is not a propagation re run: the answer changes what the campaign's lead picture is a picture of.
emergent_checkpoints.likely_rework: Re frame that studio master so the window falls outside the wide hero, which changes what the room's wide picture is about and therefore the crop logic for the whole set, or demote it and let a licensed frame lead, which changes how much of the campaign is the studio's own room and forces the calm daylight target to be re fixed off licensed photography rather than off the client's room, with every frame already corrected toward the old target re corrected afterwards.
emergent_checkpoints.failure_if_undetected: The launch page ships with a flat white rectangle where the studio's daylight window should be, on the single picture a considered buyer looks at while deciding between three studios, and the effect grows more obvious the more correctly the rest of the room is graded.

emergent_checkpoints.what_can_only_be_learned_by_running: Whether the licensed frame can actually join this room. The search surface returns a 240 px thumbnail plus true dimensions and nothing else about the light, so a frame that reads on the thumbnail as soft north light can turn out at full resolution to be lit by a large warm practical off frame, laying an amber ramp across the far wall and a warm cast into the skin. Brought toward the calm daylight target globally, the skin goes cold before the wall gives up its amber; confined to the wall, the wall's new neutral changes what the sage reformer beside it reads as. Whether the frame joins at all only becomes a question at the moment it is downloaded at full resolution and laid beside the graded studio frames, which is the first time the two have ever been adjacent.
emergent_checkpoints.why_unavoidable: (a) Ordering cannot produce that adjacency earlier, because it requires both the licence and the grade, and the pre licence readout is a 240 px proxy with no colour information worth trusting. (b) Nothing states it: the brief asks for frames chosen the way a designer chooses and for everything to look like one afternoon, which is the requirement rather than the finding. (c) It is not a propagation re run: the response is to license a different asset, which is a new shortlist, a new defence and a different lead picture.
emergent_checkpoints.likely_rework: Return to the search with what the failure taught about which lights can honestly join this room, license a replacement, grade it toward the target, re judge the whole set adjacent, and if no candidate joins, re fix the target on what the studio's own room can honestly be and re correct the licensed frames toward that instead, recording in the note why the studio frames and the licensed frames needed different corrections to arrive at the same place.
emergent_checkpoints.failure_if_undetected: The campaign's most prominent photograph carries warm practical light and warm skin against a cool sage room, which is exactly the different brand from the campaign photography that the owners said in writing would waste the money.

emergent_checkpoints.what_can_only_be_learned_by_running: What the printer's press card actually converts to. The printed pass plainly shows a portrait and the studio mark as two placed pictures and four separate blocks of copy, so the obvious plan binds a per row portrait to one graphic frame and the mark to the other and maps four fields to four frames. The converted document exposes one graphic frame and one continuous text story, because the mark was flattened into the background artwork before the file went to press and the copy was set as a single flow. Frame granularity is a property of how a retired printer built the document, it is announced nowhere, and the printed card is actively misleading about it. Any mapping row aimed at the second graphic frame is silently filtered out for naming an id that does not exist, the validator returns valid on what remains, and the preparation step reports success.
emergent_checkpoints.why_unavoidable: (a) Ordering cannot dodge it, because the inventory does not exist until the conversion has run, and the only visible evidence beforehand is the printed page, which contradicts it. (b) Nothing states it: the brief says only that the printer holds the file that went to press. (c) It is not a propagation re run: the mapping strategy changes from per frame binding to offset arithmetic inside one story with same uid rows ordered so their positions hold, the mark can no longer be swapped per card and has to be carried some other way, and the portrait's aspect is now set by the single surviving graphic frame rather than by the two the plan assumed, which sends the portrait preparation back to the imaging surface.
emergent_checkpoints.likely_rework: Recompute every copy offset against the story text reconstructed from the exported document, re author the mapping inside one flow with same uid rows in descending position order, re prepare the six portraits to the aspect the surviving graphic frame actually has, decide and state how the recovered mark reaches the pass given that the old one is baked into the background, and verify by exporting the interchange file from the prepared template and searching for every placeholder before any pass is merged.
emergent_checkpoints.failure_if_undetected: The founding member passes print with each instructor's portrait squeezed to the wrong shape in the only frame that exists, two copy fields never replaced so every pass carries last year's class name and price, and the studio mark stuck at whatever the printer flattened in a year ago.

decision_gates: Whether the mixed dusk light in the room is one problem or two, since the sage upholstery and the oak floor pull opposite ways toward one white point.
Whether the wide composing studio frame can carry the wide hero at all once the window is worked, and what leads the campaign if it cannot.
Which two moods to shortlist from Stock and which to defend, at a band where the wrong light is not merely different but off brand.
Whether a licensed frame that will not join the room is the frame's problem or the target's, and therefore whether the target moves.

Selection prompt wording on the logo export: naming the plate takes the white square, naming the letterforms' own visual properties takes the ink, and background removal on an enclosed counter is the wrong instrument entirely.
Whether the recovered wordmark came back with open counters or came back filled and plausible, which only shows when it is placed small on the pass.
How the portrait below pass scale is handled, given that nothing can enlarge it and the client expects six passes.
Whether to trust the printed card's apparent structure or the converted document's real frame inventory, and whether a success message counts as verification.

why_not_vlm: Paste the brief and the assets into a frontier image model and it returns lovely pictures of a pilates studio. IDENTITY: the campaign has to contain the actual Calloway Row room that a considered buyer will walk into after visiting two competitors, and the owners have named the mismatch between room and campaign as the failure that wastes the money; a regenerated studio is a misrepresentation. The six instructors are six real people whose faces go on a printed pass, and the wordmark is a specific drawing that must be RECOVERED from the only surviving file, not reinvented into a different studio's mark. LICENSING: the sourced photography has to be genuinely licensed, provenance clear and free of generative tech candidates, because it runs in paid placement. SPEC: the printed run needs one 89 x 51 mm pass per current instructor binding class and price verbatim, per instructor files each containing the pass they claim, and proofs at true print resolution. EDITABILITY: the launch set is defined by being editable, because the opening date has already moved once. And the middle of the engagement is verification against material reality: whether a dusk exposure held its window, whether a licensed frame's real light can join this room, whether a placeholder was ever created.
